label: Late-episode D1 after an a1 choice that went rarely to S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only late in the episode: 92% of mass falls in trials 90-99, the rest in 80-89, and nothing before trial 80. The same steps have the lowest value-head output (value < 5.2 holds 91% of mass), which likely reflects the end of the episode approaching. Within those steps it is most selective for D1 right after the previous trial chose a1 and had a rare transition to S2 (prev_common = 0 gives 76% of mass), usually unrewarded (prev_reward = 0 gives 82% of mass). It is more common in episodes where S1 is good. The largest activations come at the end of runs of repeated a1 -> S2 rare, unrewarded trials, with activation building up across consecutive D1s. It is weak or absent after common or a2 trials. Only observed variables are used. Late D1 alone reaches mass recall 0.92 but precision 0.07. Adding the a1-rare condition raises dev F1 to 0.55 (P 0.51, R 0.61, mass 0.70). Partly explained: the residual looks graded by history and time rather than a clean boolean.
